import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for brands
brand_colors = {'Leica': '#E63946', 'Fuji': '#457B9D', 'Pentax': '#2A9D8F', 'Olympus': '#E9C46A'}

# 1. Price by Brand (Bar chart)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
brand_prices = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = [brand_colors[b] for b in brand_prices.index]
bars = ax1.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
ax1.bar_label(bars, fmt='$%.0f', padding=3)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price (Scatter plot)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax2.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.8, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution (Pie chart)
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')

# 4. Weight vs Model Year (Scatter with size = megapixels)
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax4.scatter(brand_data['model_year'], brand_data['weight_grams'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], label=brand, s=brand_data['megapixels']*5, 
                alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax4.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)')
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Model Year\n(Size = Megapixels)')
ax4.legend()

# 5. Body Type Count (Bar chart)
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
colors_body = plt.cm.Pastel1(range(len(body_counts)))
bars5 = ax5.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=colors_body, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_title('Camera Body Type Distribution')
ax5.bar_label(bars5)

# 6. Max ISO by Brand (Bar chart)
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
brand_iso = df.groupby('brand')['max_iso'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_iso = [brand_colors[b] for b in brand_iso.index]

ax6.set_xlabel('Max ISO')
ax6.set_title('Average Max ISO by Brand')
ax6.bar_label(bars6, fmt='%.0f', padding=3)
